integrity: The algebraic theorem is supplemented by exhaustive exact-rational finite verifications for the two seven-vertex examples, not asserted to be established by exhaustive computation in general. No independent audit or priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Binary neutral simultaneous proportional copying on a static finite hypergraph with independent edge clocks. The iff statement requires all deterministic configurations, and equal pair-codegrees do not determine full laws. Expected-time formulas are established for the two exact seven-node examples only.
title: Pair-codegree rigidity and hidden consensus-time differences in polyadic voting
